title: Action Models
description: Action request and response models for UI interaction commands.

IncludeOption.description: Optional data to include in the action response.

CaptureEpoch.description: Epoch returned by the tree, query, hit-test, or element capture that produced the target ID. Agents advertising stale-capture-rejection reserve this epoch for one mutation request and reject stale or retargeted IDs with HTTP 409.

RegistryGeneration.description: Native registration generation returned with captureEpoch. When supplied, captureEpoch is required.

TapRequest.description: Request to perform a tap/click action on an element or at coordinates.

elementId.description: Target element identifier. Either elementId or coordinates must be provided.

x.description: X coordinate for the tap. Used when tapping by position rather than element.

y.description: Y coordinate for the tap. Used when tapping by position rather than element.

include.description: Optional data to include in the response.

FillRequest.description: Request to fill text into an input element.

text.description: Text content to fill into the element.

include.description: Optional data to include in the response.

ClearRequest.description: Request to clear the content of an input element.

include.description: Optional data to include in the response.

FocusRequest.description: Request to move input focus to an element.

elementId.description: Target element identifier to receive focus.

include.description: Optional data to include in the response.

ScrollRequest.description: Request to perform a scroll action on a scrollable element.

elementId.description: Target scrollable element identifier. If null, scrolls the primary scrollable view.

deltaX.description: Horizontal scroll delta in device-independent pixels.

deltaY.description: Vertical scroll delta in device-independent pixels.

animated.description: Whether the scroll should be animated.

itemIndex.description: Index of the item to scroll to in a list or collection view.

groupIndex.description: Index of the group containing the target item.

scrollToPosition.description: Alignment of the target item within the viewport after scrolling.

include.description: Optional data to include in the response.

NavigateRequest.description: Request to navigate to a named route or URI within the application.

route.description: Route or URI to navigate to.

include.description: Optional data to include in the response.

ResizeRequest.description: Request to resize a window or element.

elementId.description: Target window element identifier. If null, resizes the main application window.

include.description: Optional data to include in the response.

BackRequest.description: Request to perform a back navigation action.

include.description: Optional data to include in the response.

KeyRequest.description: Request to send a key press event.

include.description: Optional data to include in the response.

GestureType.description: The kind of gesture to perform.

GestureRequest.description: Request to perform a named gesture. The gesture is first offered to a matching MAUI gesture recognizer on the target element or its ancestors; if none exists it is injected natively at the platform view, which is how pinch-to-zoom reaches controls that own their gestures internally (Map, WebView, native scroll views).

elementId.description: Target element identifier. When omitted the gesture targets the window's current page.

direction.description: Finger travel direction for swipe and pan. Required for swipe. For example, 'up' moves the pointer upward and scrollable content downward.

distance.description: Travel distance in device-independent pixels for swipe and pan when using 'direction'.

durationMs.description: Total gesture duration in milliseconds. Longer durations read as drags, shorter ones as flicks. Long press defaults to 600 ms and clamps values below 500 ms.

scale.description: Pinch factor: 2.0 zooms in 2x, 0.5 zooms out by half. Used by 'pinch'; defaults to 1.5.

rotation.description: Rotation in degrees, positive is clockwise. Used by 'rotate'; defaults to 90.

deltaX.description: Explicit horizontal pan distance in device-independent pixels. Overrides direction/distance.

deltaY.description: Explicit vertical pan distance in device-independent pixels. Overrides direction/distance.

originX.description: Gesture focal point X, element-relative from 0 (left) to 1 (right).

originY.description: Gesture focal point Y, element-relative from 0 (top) to 1 (bottom).

steps.description: Number of interpolation steps emitted between the gesture's start and end.

include.description: Optional data to include in the response.

GestureResponse.description: Result of a gesture, naming the tier that serviced it.

handledBy.description: 'recognizer' — a MAUI gesture recognizer on the element or an ancestor handled it. 'native' — injected at the platform view. 'action' — the dedicated DevFlow tap action handled it. 'scroll' — the legacy swipe-to-scroll fallback ran. 'none' — nothing handled the gesture.

platform.description: Device platform that ran the gesture.

detail.description: What actually serviced the gesture, e.g. 'PinchGestureRecognizer on Grid' or 'MKMapView.Camera.CenterCoordinateDistance /2'.

error.description: Why the gesture could not be performed, when success is false.

GestureErrorResponse.description: A rejected or unhandled gesture request. Validation failures may not have a normalized gesture type; attempted gestures also report the tier outcome.

type.description: Normalized gesture type when one could be determined, otherwise the rejected caller value or null.

BatchAction.description: A single action within a batch, combining the action type with its parameters.

action.description: The type of action to perform.

x.description: X coordinate (for tap and gesture actions).

y.description: Y coordinate (for tap and gesture actions).

deltaX.description: Horizontal delta for scroll, or explicit horizontal pointer travel for gesture pan.

deltaY.description: Vertical delta for scroll, or explicit vertical pointer travel for gesture pan.

animated.description: Whether scroll should be animated (for scroll action).

itemIndex.description: Item index to scroll to (for scroll action).

groupIndex.description: Group index for scroll target (for scroll action).

route.description: Route to navigate to (for navigate action).

distance.description: Travel distance in device-independent pixels (for gesture swipe/pan).

durationMs.description: Gesture duration in milliseconds (for gesture action).

scale.description: Pinch factor (for gesture pinch): 2.0 zooms in, 0.5 zooms out.

steps.description: Interpolation steps between gesture start and end.

BatchRequest.description: Request to perform multiple actions in sequence as a single batch operation. A capture-bound batch reserves its epoch once, validates every referenced target before the first mutation, and revalidates each target before execution. Earlier successful actions remain applied when a later action fails.

actions.description: Ordered list of actions to perform.

include.description: Optional data to include in the response.

continueOnError.description: Whether to continue executing remaining actions if one fails.

ActionResponse.description: Response returned after executing an action, optionally including a screenshot and/or visual tree.

error.description: Error details if the action failed.

screenshot.description: Base64-encoded screenshot taken after the action, if requested via include.

tree.description: Visual tree snapshot taken after the action, if requested via include.
